div.p: 12,000 on-campus residents across 18 residence halls and apartment complexes. 14 dining locations serving globally inspired, nutritionist-approved meals — from all-you-can-eat dining halls to specialty cafés.
Purpose-built for first-year students. Double and triple rooms with shared bathrooms, communal study lounges, and a live-in Resident Advisor on every floor.
For sophomores and above. Private bedrooms grouped around a shared lounge, kitchenette, and en-suite bathrooms. Located at the heart of the social campus zone.
Self-contained studio and one-bedroom apartments for graduate students and families. Full kitchen, in-unit laundry, and dedicated parking. Quiet study-focused community.

ul.li: Keycard access control on all entrances
Emergency call stations on every floor

div.p: 14 dining locations across campus — from our flagship 800-seat Main Dining Hall open 7am–midnight, to specialty restaurants, grab-and-go cafés, and late-night snack bars.

ul.li: The Grand Hall — all-day dining, open 7am–midnight, 800 seats
The Commons Café — specialty coffee, pastries, quick bites
Spice Route — rotating Asian, South Asian, and Middle Eastern menus
Axion Late Night — open until 2am, 5 nights a week
Vegan & vegetarian options at every location

div.p: Housing applications are only available to confirmed students. Accept your offer and pay the enrollment deposit to unlock the housing portal.
Log in to the Housing Portal at housing.Axion.edu. Select your preferred residence type and roommate preferences.
Select a meal plan during the housing application. All on-campus residents are required to have at least the Flex 10 plan in their first year.
Room assignments are sent via email in July for Fall semester. You can request a reassignment within 2 weeks of receiving your assignment.
Move-in takes place the Friday before classes start. You'll receive a scheduled time slot to avoid congestion. RAs will be on hand to help you settle in.
